Caline Caline CP-xx series browse by type simulation acoustic simulation browse by enclosure pedal Caline CP-43 Pegasus - Overdrive Published on November 10, 2017 Caline CP-xx series acoustic simulation pedal Information Caline Music The original Centaur was a brilliant sounding pedal but getting hold of one now is going to cost you a hell of a lot. Caline have produced their own pedal based on the Klon which sounds great but is available at a fraction of the cost. It performs much the same as the original but doesn't take up quite as much space. Incredibly versatile like the original the Pegasus can create a range of amazing natural sounding distortion tones. It's very transparent when Gain is set quite low, and still sounds very smooth when cranked up higher. Specifications Overdrive pedal. Based on the classic Klon Centaur Golden Professional. Simple Tone Gain and Vol controls. Durable fully metal enclosure. True Bypass.
